title: Prenatal exposure to insecticides and child cardiometabolic risk factors in the VHEMBE birth cohort.
ehr_evidence: Mothers giving birth at Tshilizidini hospital in South Africa’s Limpopo Province were recruited into the VHEMBE study between August 2012 and December 2013.
summary: Prospective birth cohort study evaluating associations between prenatal exposure to DDT and pyrethroid insecticides and child cardiometabolic risk factors at 5 years of age in Limpopo, South Africa.
key_findings: Maternal concentrations of all four pyrethroid metabolites were associated with reduced BMI z-scores (e.g., β cis-DBCA = −0.18, 95% CI = −0.33, −0.03), smaller waist circumferences (e.g., β cis-DBCA = −0.57, 95% CI = −1.09, −0.06), and decreased body fat percentages (e.g., β cis-DBCA = −0.75, 95% CI = −1.34, −0.17) per 10-fold higher concentration.

Reductions in BMI z-score were observed only among children of mothers with sufficient energy intake during pregnancy (β cis-DCCA = −0.43, 95% CI = −0.73, −0.14; β trans-DCCA = −0.40, 95% CI = −0.67, −0.12; p interaction = 0.03 and 0.04, respectively).
Maternal p,p’-DDT concentrations were associated with a reduction in body fat percentage (β = −0.39%, 95% CI = −0.76, −0.02).
Pyrethroids were not associated with child height or weight z-scores or blood pressure overall.
trans-DCCA concentrations were associated with higher height z-score among girls (β = 0.23, 95% CI = 0.05, 0.41) but not boys (β = −0.06, 95% CI = −0.25, 0.14; p interaction = 0.04).
captured_features: child height, weight, BMI, body fat percentage, waist circumference
household wealth and food security indices
population: pregnant women and their children in Limpopo, South Africa; children assessed at 5 years of age (n=637)
exposure_domain: prenatal exposure to insecticides (DDT, DDE, pyrethroids) from indoor residual spraying
limitations: single peripartum measurement of exposure may introduce nondifferential measurement error
residual confounding or chance could explain findings
exposure may originate from sources other than IRS
